name: SVC Industries Limited
about: SVC Industries Limited engages in the trading and warehousing of agricultural products in India. The company operates an agricultural research training development center, as well as trades in wheat, paddy, maize, potato, and mustard. It serves farmers and companies. The company was formerly known as SVC Superchem Limited and changed its name to SVC Industries Limited in August 2017. SVC Industries Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Mumbai, India.
